name: Enterprise Contract Landscape
constraints: Contract Landscape is a governed read-only profile and Obligation Network is its dependency and deadline graph rendering.
Released output is immutable and digest-identified; neither construct creates a business-object identity.
WM-ECO-006 masters agreement work and expression identity, clauses, amendments, party positions, termination and survival declarations.
WM-XCT-029 masters each obligation, occurrence, lifecycle, deadline, fulfilment, non-performance, excuse and consequence.
Obligations cite stable clause-work identifiers and expression versions without duplicating normative clause text.
Agreement and obligation lifecycles remain separate; amendments re-derive only affected duties.
Delegation preserves obligation identity while release-and-substitute novation creates a successor obligation.
Dependency edges distinguish antecedent, reciprocal order-of-performance and decomposition and name counterpart obligations.
Cycles and unresolved dependencies remain visible and are never silently ordered.
Contract termination or expiry never implies termination of every obligation.
Due schedules preserve trigger, due basis, recurrence version, time zone, business-day convention and legally relevant local time.
Fulfilment evidence binds to a specific occurrence and quantity; elapsed time alone never proves discharge.
Overdue, declared non-performance, excuse, dispute and cure remain independent facets.
Cross-agreement conflicts retain attributed precedence assertions and never compute a legal winner.
Non-party access is deny-by-default and requires WM-XCT-002 authorization plus WM-XCT-003 least-disclosure shape.
Dependency edges are WM-XCT-029 obligation associations mastered with their source and target duty references; the projection never creates, edits or deletes them.

Evidence and record identity remain mastered by WM-REC-001 or the applicable record authority; obligations hold governed references and agreement expiry never orphans, purges or remasters those records.
The projection digest binds agreement-set and exact expression revisions, obligation-set and revisions, as-of, party lens, policy/access decision, disclosure shape and graph-engine revision.
A surviving-duty binding to an expired agreement is a historical source reference only; it neither implies agreement liveness nor disappears on agreement expiry.

Cycles are retained in structured graph storage and rendering; reciprocal cycles are valid, while decomposition cycles are surfaced for WM-ACT-034 assessment and are never silently removed or linearized.
Landscape and Network have no write path; optional agreement grouping nodes are identity-less rendering constructs and cannot become portfolio or commercial masters.

Every evidence reference pins record-authority identity, record identity and evidence-reference revision; authority is resolved from the referenced record declaration and an absent or ambiguous authority fails closed.
WM-XCT-029 may reference evidence but never masters evidence content, record lifecycle or record access policy.
The Enterprise adoption package masters the profile-definition revision only; WM-XCT-003 masters disclosure shape and the external graph-engine release masters the pinned rendering contract.
Cycle surfacing is a non-mutating diagnostic sent out of band for WM-ACT-034 assessment and creates no flag, edge or assessment artifact inside the projection.
Disclosure is graph-closed: hiding a node also hides every incident edge, emits no placeholder, and graph layout or ordering carries no precedence semantics.
Deadline evaluation pins calendar revision, time zone and clock basis; overdue is derived at read time for the pinned as-of and is never stored as authoritative duty state.
The digest is party-lens scoped; different lens digests are not evidence that the underlying agreement, duty or record content differs.
Enterprise Contract Landscape is the sole canonical profile name; Obligation Network is a declared rendering mode of the same projection and cannot be registered independently.
holds: WM-ECO-006 and WM-XCT-029 remain non-canonical reviewable drafts.
Their composition is not ratified in the relationship ledger.
Reciprocal withholding, insolvency effects, obligations-register operations and statutory-source boundaries remain unresolved.
No verified semantic crosswalk or canonical fixtures exist.
Frozen audit limits were remediated once; canonical enforcement remains required before publication.
